notes.title: Release of COSMIC HOLES DEMO
notes.notes: To celebrate the release of the demo version of COSMIC HOLES, a 30% discount on the full game is available from June 5, 2023 to June 12, 2023.

notes.title: Proposal of exchange of services.
notes.notes:
The "Little Green" needs you to solve the most complicated puzzles.

In exchange, he offers you a guided tour to get a quick start in the game COSMIC HOLES.

Feel free to recommend the game on Steam to bring an army of brains to the "Little Green". Thank you!
